editorial.blurb: Bar Mar is a stunning seafood destination with soaring ceilings, thoughtful service, and impeccably fresh dishes that justify the visit alone.
editorial.insiderTip: Request a seat with outdoor seating if available, ask your server (especially Billy or Ronnie) for cocktail recommendations off-menu, and don't skip the Neptune Pillows—reviewers call them an absolute must-order.

topDishes.note: reviewers' absolute favorite and a total must-order
crispy skin, tender meat, and a dairy-free yet creamy sauce
